speaker: Doctor
text:
The granular yellow-white opacities and hemorrhages are highly characteristic of CMV retinitis, a common opportunistic infection in AIDS patients with low CD4 counts. Given the classic presentation and your history, I am confident in this diagnosis.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis
